taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-07 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-07
Curve type: QHA (as filed) – **discrepancy flagged**: the resistivity sequence ρ1(2831.4)<ρ2(3567.9)>ρ3(3454.3)<ρ4(11701.4)<ρ5(140416.4) actually fits a K‑H‑A pattern, not Q‑H‑A. Recommend the interpreter re‑check the curve classification before finalizing the report.

Aquifer depth: 19.27 m – 40.91 m (Layer 3)

Recommendation: The comparatively low‑resistivity Layer 3 (3454.3 Ω·m), sandwiched between higher‑resistivity units above and below, is consistent with a fractured/weathered water‑bearing zone typical of a K‑type signature. Plan the production borehole to screen the 19.3–40.9 m interval, and verify the formal curve‑type designation (KHA) in the file before finalizing the drilling design.
